race.comment: ICEFORD (1) couldn't run down the leader fresh who had an absolute picnic in front but he was strong to the line. Better for the run and gets an important 2kg claim. Will prove harder to stop with that run under his belt. CHARLEROI (4) couldn't live up to market expectation last time but wasn't beaten far when finishing strong into second over a shorter trip. The extra ground should suit and he remains right in the mix. BOLD DESIGN (5) has good early speed and gets Clark aboard who'll be eager to dictate from the inside alley. Rock-hard fit now and will take some running down if left alone. RUSH ATTACK (6) hasn't won for a long time but is knocking on the door on the quick back-up and gets Lloyd. Have to include. NORTHERN EYES (2) strips fitter third-up and gets an important 3kg claim to aid the big weight. Is yet to miss the placings over this trip. Keeping safe.
